resources.string: So Sadiq can step in instantly.
HyperOS needs a special permission to show a full-screen pop-up. Without it, Sadiq may take a moment longer to ask.
Open pop-up settings
Sadiq needs "No restrictions" in Battery saver.
HyperOS automatically puts apps to sleep. Sadiq needs to stay awake to guard your feeds.
Open Battery saver
I set "No restrictions"
So Sadiq comes back after a restart.
HyperOS disables autostart by default for many apps. Sadiq needs it to keep guarding your feeds.
Open Autostart
I turned on Autostart
Lock Sadiq in Recents.
HyperOS clears apps from memory to save battery. Lock Sadiq so it is always there.
I locked it
Installed apps
Settings → Additional settings → Accessibility → Downloaded apps → Sadiq → turn on "Use Sadiq" → Allow.
Settings → Additional settings → Accessibility → Installed apps → Sadiq → turn on "Use Sadiq" → Allow.
Other permissions → "Display pop-up windows while running in the background" → Always allow.
Other permissions → "Open new windows while running in the background" → Always allow.
App info → Battery saver → No restrictions.
Find Sadiq → turn on Autostart.
App info → Autostart.
Swipe up from the bottom and hold to open Recents → press and hold the Sadiq card → tap the lock icon.
